CA.rationale: Content (red) is identified and explicitly bound to a processing condition ('kind":"command_estimate') for the same referent/time.

COD.rationale: Content (red) lines and a separate origin line (organization/access) are present for the same referent/time, showing content, organization and status separation.

A.rationale: Processing condition ('command_estimate') is explicitly tied to the same content referent (candidate/k0/n0).

C.rationale: Explicit content entries identify grid content (red) with coordinates for a named referent.

D.rationale: Origin (status/organization) is recorded separately from content coordinates for the same referent, distinguishing content identity from its organization/access status.

O.rationale: Origin entries describe how the content is represented/organized (kind, represented_time) for the named referent.
